item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya keeps a potted tulsi plant on her sunny balcony in Jaipur. Her teacher asks her to complete the word equation for photosynthesis. Which statement completes it correctly?

options.A: Glucose and oxygen, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into carbon dioxide and water.
options.B: Carbon dioxide and water, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into glucose and oxygen.
options.C: Carbon dioxide and water are changed into glucose and oxygen even when the plant is kept in a dark room.
options.D: Oxygen and water, in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll, are changed into glucose and carbon dioxide.
